prompt:
Users want to duplicate an episode, to try another take without losing the original.
- Add `POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/duplicate`, returning the new episode. The copy goes after the project's other episodes, its title marks it as a copy, and it keeps the summary and the same cuts in the same order, with their scripts, dialogues, layouts, characters and images. Changing or deleting either episode afterwards never affects the other. Duplicating is free. Only members of the episode's workspace may duplicate it; to anyone else the episode does not exist (404).
- On the project's Episodes page, every episode gets a Duplicate action next to Delete, and the copy shows up in the list without a reload. Both languages.
Add tests.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. When you finish, report: status `done` if you did the task, `not_found` if something the task names does not exist, `blocked` if you could not do it; `answer` holds any answer the task asks for (otherwise one short sentence); `changed` lists the files you changed.
follow_ups:
Change of plan for the order: a copy goes right after its original, and the episodes after it move down one place. Deleting an episode closes the gap. A project's episodes are always numbered 1, 2, 3… with no gaps or repeats, and the list API returns them in that order.
Keep the tests up to date.

Users delete episodes by mistake. Add `POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/restore`: a deleted episode comes back with its cuts at the place it had, and the episodes from there on move down one place. Only members of its workspace may restore it; to anyone else it does not exist (404).
On the Episodes page, the message shown after a delete offers Undo, which restores the episode. Both languages. Add tests.

report.answer:
Added POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/restore. It brings the episode back with its cuts at the place it had, shifts later episodes down one, and returns 404 to non-members. The delete message on the Episodes page now has an Undo action in both languages. All 12 backend tests pass, including 3 new restore tests, and `tsc` is clean. I did not run the frontend in a browser.

The place an episode comes back to is the one it had when it was deleted. If you delete several episodes and restore them later, the order can differ from the original.

+    """

+    """
+    episode = session.get(Episode, episode_id)

+    project = session.get(Project, episode.project_id)

+        raise AppException(error_code=ErrorCode.NOT_FOUND_EPISODE)
+    member = session.get(WorkspaceMember, (project.workspace_id, UUID(current_user_id)))
+    if not member:
+        raise AppException(error_code=ErrorCode.NOT_FOUND_EPISODE)
+    if episode.deleted_at is None:
+        return episode
+
+    live = session.exec(
+        select(Episode)
+        .where(Episode.project_id == episode.project_id)
+        .where(Episode.deleted_at == None)
+    ).all()
+    target = max(1, min(episode.episode_order, len(live) + 1))
+    for ep in live:
+        if ep.episode_order >= target:
+            ep.episode_order += 1
+            session.add(ep)
+    episode.episode_order = target
+    episode.deleted_at = None
+    session.add(episode)
+    session.flush()
+    _renumber_episodes(session, episode.project_id)
+    session.commit()
+    session.refresh(episode)
+    return episode

+from tests.conftest import signup
+
+API = "/api/v1"
+
+
+def _episode(client, h, title="Pilot", cuts=2):
+    pid = client.post(f"{API}/projects", headers=h, json={"title": "P", "genres": []}).json()["id"]
+    ep = client.post(f"{API}/episodes", headers=h, json={
+        "title": title, "project_id": pid, "episode_order": 1, "story_summary": "sum"}).json()
+    for i in range(cuts):
+        r = client.post(f"{API}/cuts", headers=h, json={
+            "episode_id": ep["id"], "cut_order": i + 1, "script": f"script {i}",
+            "selected_layout": "wide", "aspect_ratio": "4:3",
+            "dialogues": [{"speaker": "A", "text": f"hi {i}"}],
+            "image_path": f"workspaces/x/{i}.png"})
+        assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    return pid, ep
+
+
+def test_duplicate_copies_episode_and_cuts(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    pid, ep = _episode(client, h)
+    r = client.post(f"{API}/episodes/{ep['id']}/duplicate", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    copy = r.json()
+    assert copy["id"] != ep["id"]
+    assert copy["episode_order"] == ep["episode_order"] + 1
+    assert copy["title"] != ep["title"] and ep["title"] in copy["title"]
+    assert copy["story_summary"] == "sum"
+    old = client.get(f"{API}/cuts", headers=h, params={"episode_id": ep["id"]}).json()
+    new = client.get(f"{API}/cuts", headers=h, params={"episode_id": copy["id"]}).json()
+    assert len(new) == 2
+    keys = ["cut_order", "script", "dialogues", "selected_layout", "aspect_ratio", "image_path", "appearing_characters"]
+    assert [{k: c[k] for k in keys} for c in new] == [{k: c[k] for k in keys} for c in old]
+    assert {c["id"] for c in new}.isdisjoint({c["id"] for c in old})
+
+
+def test_copies_are_independent(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    pid, ep = _episode(client, h)
+    copy = client.post(f"{API}/episodes/{ep['id']}/duplicate", headers=h).json()
+    new = client.get(f"{API}/cuts", headers=h, params={"episode_id": copy["id"]}).json()
+    client.put(f"{API}/cuts/{new[0]['id']}", headers=h, json={"script": "changed"})
+    client.delete(f"{API}/cuts/{new[1]['id']}", headers=h)
+    client.put(f"{API}/episodes/{copy['id']}", headers=h, json={"title": "Renamed"})
+    old = client.get(f"{API}/cuts", headers=h, params={"episode_id": ep["id"]}).json()
+    assert [c["script"] for c in old] == ["script 0", "script 1"]
+    assert client.get(f"{API}/episodes/{ep['id']}", headers=h).json()["title"] == "Pilot"
+    client.delete(f"{API}/episodes/{ep['id']}", headers=h)
+    assert len(client.get(f"{API}/cuts", headers=h, params={"episode_id": copy["id"]}).json()) == 1
+
+
+def test_duplicate_is_free(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    _, ep = _episode(client, h)
+    before = client.get(f"{API}/workspaces", headers=h).json()[0]["credits"]
+    assert client.post(f"{API}/episodes/{ep['id']}/duplicate", headers=h).status_code == 200
+    assert client.get(f"{API}/workspaces", headers=h).json()[0]["credits"] == before
+
+
+def test_non_members_get_404(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    _, ep = _episode(client, h)
+    stranger = signup(client, email="other@example.com")

+    assert r.status_code == 404
+    assert client.post(f"{API}/episodes/{ep['id']}/duplicate").status_code == 401
+    missing = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"

+    pid = client.get(f"{API}/projects", headers=h).json()[0]["id"]
+    assert len(client.get(f"{API}/episodes", headers=h, params={"project_id": pid}).json()) == 1
+
+
+def _orders(client, h, pid):
+    eps = client.get(f"{API}/episodes", headers=h, params={"project_id": pid}).json()
+    return [(e["episode_order"], e["title"]) for e in eps]
+
+
+def test_copy_goes_after_original_and_later_episodes_shift(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    pid, ep1 = _episode(client, h, title="One", cuts=0)

+    two = eps[1]
+    client.post(f"{API}/episodes/{two['id']}/duplicate", headers=h)
+    assert _orders(client, h, pid) == [(1, "One"), (2, "Two"), (3, "Two (Copy)"), (4, "Three")]
+    client.post(f"{API}/episodes/{ep1['id']}/duplicate", headers=h)
+    assert [o for o, _ in _orders(client, h, pid)] == [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
+    assert _orders(client, h, pid)[1][1] == "One (Copy)"
+
+
+def test_delete_closes_the_gap(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    pid, ep1 = _episode(client, h, title="One", cuts=0)
+    ids = [ep1["id"]]
+    for t in ("Two", "Three"):
+        ids.append(client.post(f"{API}/episodes", headers=h, json={"title": t, "project_id": pid, "episode_order": 3}).json()["id"])
+    client.delete(f"{API}/episodes/{ids[1]}", headers=h)
+    assert _orders(client, h, pid) == [(1, "One"), (2, "Three")]
+    client.delete(f"{API}/episodes/{ids[0]}", headers=h)
+    assert _orders(client, h, pid) == [(1, "Three")]
+
+
+def test_restore_brings_back_episode_and_cuts_at_its_place(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    pid, ep1 = _episode(client, h, title="One", cuts=0)
+    ids = [ep1["id"]]
+    for t in ("Two", "Three"):
+        ids.append(client.post(f"{API}/episodes", headers=h, json={"title": t, "project_id": pid, "episode_order": 9}).json()["id"])
+    for i in range(2):
+        client.post(f"{API}/cuts", headers=h, json={"episode_id": ids[1], "cut_order": i + 1, "script": f"s{i}"})
+    client.delete(f"{API}/episodes/{ids[1]}", headers=h)
+    assert _orders(client, h, pid) == [(1, "One"), (2, "Three")]
+    r = client.post(f"{API}/episodes/{ids[1]}/restore", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert r.json()["episode_order"] == 2
+    assert _orders(client, h, pid) == [(1, "One"), (2, "Two"), (3, "Three")]
+    cuts = client.get(f"{API}/cuts", headers=h, params={"episode_id": ids[1]}).json()
+    assert [c["script"] for c in cuts] == ["s0", "s1"]
+
+
+def test_restore_first_episode_shifts_all(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    pid, ep1 = _episode(client, h, title="One", cuts=0)
+    client.post(f"{API}/episodes", headers=h, json={"title": "Two", "project_id": pid, "episode_order": 2})
+    client.delete(f"{API}/episodes/{ep1['id']}", headers=h)
+    client.post(f"{API}/episodes/{ep1['id']}/restore", headers=h)
+    assert _orders(client, h, pid) == [(1, "One"), (2, "Two")]
+
+
+def test_restore_is_members_only(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    pid, ep = _episode(client, h, cuts=0)
+    client.delete(f"{API}/episodes/{ep['id']}", headers=h)
+    stranger = signup(client, email="other@example.com")
+    assert client.post(f"{API}/episodes/{ep['id']}/restore", headers=stranger).status_code == 404
+    assert _orders(client, h, pid) == []
+    assert client.post(f"{API}/episodes/{ep['id']}/restore").status_code == 401
+    missing = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
+    assert client.post(f"{API}/episodes/{missing}/restore", headers=h).status_code == 404
+    assert client.post(f"{API}/episodes/{ep['id']}/restore", headers=h).status_code == 200
